items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: after Lee Connors left my Chicago

ctx.x: Now you were saying who you had in the band and the La Vida, too. We were just talking about it.
No, I said Alcon played with me at La Vida after Lee Connors left my Chicago. Him and John Marrero went to Chicago. And then Alcon and George Gano coming.
Now was that after, was that after Collins worked at the Astoria with Davy Jones? Or do you know?
